data.name: CreateCredentialDescription
data.value:
A new passkey (FIDO2 credential) will now be created for this database. Enter below the name of the device used to create the key — it distinguishes it from others in the database device list. If left empty, the label will be made from the device type, computer name and date.
In the "Windows Security" window, choose: • a FIDO2 security key with hmac-secret/PRF support (YubiKey 5, etc.) — enter its PIN and touch it; • Windows Hello — PIN, face or fingerprint; • a phone or tablet — scan the QR code and confirm on the phone.
Other devices: File → Database Settings → "FIDO2" tab.

data.name: DiagPrfTestConfirm
data.value:
A TEST credential will now be created. Depending on your choice in the "Windows Security" window, it is created on a FIDO2 security key, in Windows Hello or on a phone (a passkey on a phone is synced to the provider account, e.g. Google).
You will need to confirm the creation and then the use of the credential (PIN, touch, biometrics).
The test does NOT affect your databases, but the test credential stays on the authenticator and takes a discoverable credential slot. To remove it: • Windows Hello — in the Windows Hello list of the "Tools → KeePassPasskeyKeyProvider" window or in Settings → Accounts → Passkeys; • security key — with the manufacturer's tool (e.g. Yubico Authenticator, ykman) or in a browser's security key settings; • phone — in the password manager of the passkey provider.
Do NOT reset the security key in Windows Settings: a reset deletes all its credentials, including those that open your databases.
Continue the test?

data.name: RecoveryInputDescription
data.value:
Enter the {0} recovery phrase words separated by spaces in the original order. Case does not matter; words can be shortened to their first 4 letters.
After opening the database, add a new device: File → Database Settings → "FIDO2" tab.

data.name: RecoveryPhraseCreated
data.value: A recovery phrase has been created: it opens the database without a device.

data.name: RecoveryPhraseInstructions
data.value:
Write the recovery phrase down on paper and keep it in a safe place.
The phrase opens the database without a FIDO2 device (together with the password or key file, if the master key has them). Do not store it in files, the cloud or photos. Remove a lost or compromised phrase on the "FIDO2" tab — the database master key will be replaced.
The phrase is shown only now: you will not be able to view it later.

data.name: RemoveDeviceConfirm
data.value:
Remove device "{0}"?
The database master key will be replaced with a new one and the database saved. The removed device will not be able to open this database or any of its later versions; the other devices will keep opening it without re-registration.
Copies of the database made before the removal (backups, version history in the cloud) can still be opened by this device: if the database contains secrets it should not have access to, change them.
